question.text: Consider the statement <math><mi>p</mi><mi></mi><mo>:</mo></math> If a hexagon is regular then all its sides and angles are equal. The contrapositive of statement <math><mi>p</mi></math> is

options.text: If all sides and angles of a hexagon are not equal then it is not regular
If all sides and angles of a hexagon are equal then it is regular
If all sides and angles of a hexagon are not equal then it is regular
If all sides and angles of a hexagon are equal then it is not regular

solution.text:
Contrapositive of “If p then q” is “If ~q then ~p” hence contrapositive is
“If all sides and angles of a hexagon are not equal then it is not regular”
